text:
julian: heads up — starting a small bake for release v3.2.0 in ~10m. planning canary 5% for EU and NA. change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. deploy-bot will kickoff at 23:05. pinging ops & oncall. @sre-oncall

deploy-bot: triggered deploy v3.2.0 -> canary 5% (EU,NA). RunID: db-1791234567. dashboard: https://deploys.internal/release/db-1791234567

aisha: please pin config to v3.2.0-rc2 for Dedicated pools. avoid rolling autoscaler changes during the bake.

raj: rollback triggers for this run: error rate >1.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency +200ms over baseline. also watch KV cache OOM and 5xx spike.

sre-oncall: I'll watch traces, tail latency, and kvm metrics. flipping routing log-level to DEBUG for 10m to capture samples.

kevin: release notes are ready (short bullets + migration note). doc: https://docs.internal/release-notes/v3.2.0 — will update if anything comes up.

maria: note: this build includes a quantization tweak. checking embed pipeline to ensure dims/schema unaffected. will confirm.

ops-bot: change window scheduled: 2025-05-12T23:00Z - 2025-05-13T01:00Z. Pager rotation updated.

julian: runbook snippet for quick rollback if needed:
```
# quick rollback
deploybot rollback --run db-1791234567 --traffic 0
# then pin infra to v3.1.9
```
Keep commit ID: abc1234 in case we need to repro.

deploy-bot: canary ramp to 5% now. Instances adjusted: 24 -> 25. healthchecks passing. logs: https://logs.internal/db-1791234567/canary.log

raj: seeing a small tail increase in eu-west-1 p95 (+40ms) but not at alert threshold yet. continuing watch :eyes: \\n
aisha: pinned Dedicated pools to v3.2.0-rc2 (infra console updated).

kevin: tiny docs tweak requested from product — adding note about tokenization edge-case. will push a patch to the release doc.

sre-oncall: traces & error rate look flat. starting a 5m heartbeat monitor; will post if anything degrades.

maria: confirmed: embedding dims unchanged, quantize tweak did not alter schema. false alarm.

julian: consensus: go to proceed to 15% at +15m unless any trigger fires. can people ACK with +1 when ready?

kevin: +1

aisha: +1

raj: +1 (watching KV usage closely)

deploy-bot: scheduled traffic bump to 15% in 15m. command queued: `deploybot promote --run db-1791234567 --to 15`

sre-oncall: starting a 5m heartbeat now and tagging #oncall to keep eyes on the run.

julian: thanks all. if we need to abort, run the rollback command above and ping #eng-releases. staying on standby.
